result.summary: The page looks generally well-structured with no critical visual breakages. One minor layout issue was identified.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated without an ellipsis indicator, making it unclear to users that the name is cut off.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis to the restaurant name label to clearly indicate the text is truncated, or ensure the card width accommodates the full name.
